categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Yanmade Technology Inc. focuses on the research, design, production, and sales of industrial automation and intelligent testing equipment and accessories, primarily serving the electronic industry. Its main products include automated testing equipment, test fixtures, and related components, targeting sectors such as consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and communications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies in precision mechanics, test measurement, motion control, machine vision, intelligent equipment software, and artificial intelligence. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including automated and semi-automated testing systems, AI-based visual defect detection, and custom test fixture design. Continuous R&D investment supports innovations like MEMS sensor testing, RF non-contact probe testing, and rapid module switching technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading global manufacturers in flexible printed circuit (FPC) production, including top-tier consumer electronics brands such as Apple. The company serves industries including consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, wearables), automotive electronics, and communication equipment, with a strong focus on FPC testing and semiconductor testing markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Shenzhen and Hangzhou. The company has expanded globally with subsidiaries and manufacturing bases in Singapore, Vietnam, and plans for a factory in Thailand, supporting customers in Southeast Asia and beyond.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yanmade operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, providing specialized automated testing equipment and solutions for manufacturers of flexible printed circuits and semiconductor components. It acts as a key equipment supplier enabling quality control and production efficiency for downstream electronics manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes deepening its leadership in FPC automated testing while expanding into semiconductor testing (MEMS sensors, IC substrates) and automotive electronics testing. It emphasizes AI-driven intelligent testing, machine vision upgrades, and integration of advanced control technologies. Strategic acquisitions, such as Singapore's AxisTec, accelerate entry into high-value silicon photonics wafer inspection markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized automated testing equipment and test fixtures. The company also offers retrofit services to upgrade existing equipment. Pricing follows a cost-plus model reflecting product customization, R&D investment, and market conditions. After-sales services and technical support complement product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yanmade is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in the FPC testing equipment industry, recognized for its technological innovation and strong customer relationships with global top FPC manufacturers. It competes with international and local players in the smart manufacturing and semiconductor testing equipment sectors, leveraging its R&D capabilities and cost advantages to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 497.6 million, a 52.2% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 96.3 million, up 40.46%. R&D expenses accounted for 24.33% of revenue, reflecting strong investment in innovation. The company has shown consistent growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, supported by expanding market demand and new business segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yanmade emphasizes its comprehensive integration of precision mechanical design, advanced test measurement, and AI-driven intelligent automation to deliver highly customized, efficient, and reliable testing solutions. Its products improve manufacturing quality and efficiency for customers, with strong adaptability to fast product iterations and complex testing requirements. The company’s local presence and deep industry knowledge provide superior service and faster response times compared to foreign competitors.
